14 new stories in the Rochdale borough since yesterday morning.

The stories

  • Man arrested for possessing imitation firearm at Rochdale Armistice Day event Rochdale
    A man in his 50s was arrested for possessing an imitation firearm during a remembrance ceremony in Rochdale town centre.
  • Man who died in Baguley Crescent flat fire in Middleton named as David Mills, 67 Middleton
    David Steven Mills died at the scene of a fire in his first-floor flat on Saturday 7 November. Police say there are no suspicious circumstances.
  • Christmas giving in Rochdale: the toy appeal, the foodbank and the mayor's charities Rochdale
    New, unwrapped toys for children aged up to 16 are needed by Friday 11 December, while Rochdale Foodbank is short of juice, rice, toothpaste and coffee.
  • Police search for man who helped woman after alleged sexual assault in Rochdale Rochdale
    Greater Manchester Police are appealing for information regarding a man who assisted a woman following an alleged sexual assault in Rochdale town centre.
  • Springhill Hospice appeals for volunteers to collect Christmas trees in January Rochdale
    Springhill Hospice needs volunteers and drivers with vans or trucks for its Christmas tree recycling collections from Friday 15 to Monday 18 January 2027.
  • Rochdale commemorates Armistice Day at Cenotaph Rochdale
    Rochdale marked Armistice Day with a ceremony at the Cenotaph, honouring those who served in the armed forces.
  • Middleton man charged with attempted murder and three aggravated burglaries Middleton
    A 33-year-old man from the Middleton area is due before Manchester Magistrates' Court following charges relating to alleged incidents in Oldham.
  • Rochdale’s own Stonehenge? What archaeologists actually know about the moorland stones Rochdale
    Surveys and excavations show Bronze Age cairns and widespread prehistoric flint scatters on the moors above Rochdale — but the idea of a local ‘Stonehenge’ is disputed and needs more professional…
  • ILEARN International Limited to be wound up following resolutions Rochdale
    ILEARN International Limited, based in Rochdale, has passed resolutions for voluntary winding-up, appointing a liquidator to oversee the process.
  • Sanderson's Floor & Roof Truss Company Limited enters liquidation Milnrow
    Sanderson's Floor & Roof Truss Company Limited, based at 179 Milnrow Road, Rochdale, has entered liquidation as of 12 November 2026, according to an official notice in The Gazette.
  • Rochdale shop iREEF named Marine Fish Retailer of the Year 2026 Rochdale
    iREEF, a Rochdale-based aquatic retailer, has been awarded Marine Fish Retailer of the Year in Practical Fishkeeping's annual Readers' Poll.
  • Six dental practices in Rochdale borough listed as taking new NHS adult patients Rochdale
    NHS listings show six practices accepting new adult patients and eight accepting children. None in Heywood or Littleborough is taking adults.

Weather: Sunny 6°C in Rochdale today.

Rochdale’s own Stonehenge? What archaeologists actually know about the moorland stones (Rochdale). Surveys and excavations show Bronze Age cairns and widespread prehistoric flint scatters on the moors above Rochdale — but the idea of a local ‘Stonehenge’ is disputed and needs more professional…

ILEARN International Limited to be wound up following resolutions (Rochdale). ILEARN International Limited, based in Rochdale, has passed resolutions for voluntary winding-up, appointing a liquidator to oversee the process.

Sanderson's Floor & Roof Truss Company Limited enters liquidation (Milnrow). Sanderson's Floor & Roof Truss Company Limited, based at 179 Milnrow Road, Rochdale, has entered liquidation as of 12 November 2026, according to an official notice in The Gazette.

Rochdale shop iREEF named Marine Fish Retailer of the Year 2026 (Rochdale). iREEF, a Rochdale-based aquatic retailer, has been awarded Marine Fish Retailer of the Year in Practical Fishkeeping's annual Readers' Poll.
